scope: Intended validity unresolved; known intentional structural divergence, mechanism verified.

alternatives.A: Observed Zend acceptance establishes implementation mismatch, not intended language membership sufficient for this phase to authorize a correction.
alternatives.B: Rejected as a complete disposition: get/set-only EBNF is narrower than Zend parser T_STRING. Missing contextual functionality alone does not explain native false rejection.
alternatives.C: No authoritative intended restriction covering discarded declarations establishes a compiler defect.
alternatives.D: Retain blocker; require intended-validity adjudication or concrete separately reviewed bounded exclusion/correction.

originalDefinitions.claim: Audit dispositions, not permission to waive release gates

blockers.construct: Compiler/AST/optimizer, declaration linking, contextual traversal and unassociated upstream test changes
blockers.missingEvidence: 230 effective pending-direct-review hunk records and 14 examined-unresolved records remain, plus bounded-group uncertainties, outside-ledger implementation paths and PHPT/component associations. These are not counts of language changes.
blockers.risk: An unrepresented validity change may remain; broad discovery cannot close.
blockers.draftImpact: Continue independently justified work with explicit incomplete status.
blockers.remediation: Review the exact hunk IDs and source functions in the ledger; associate relevant tests, inspect transitive validation and optimizer/linking paths, and record evidence-backed exclusions or Gate B changes.

blockers.classification: unresolved intended validity; source-explained compiler/VM implementation defect
blockers.construct: Assignment/reference/list-derived dimension and property writes, compound/inc/unset/reference operations
blockers.missingEvidence: Authoritative intended-validity decision for exact write forms, coherent compiler/VM fix and source-corresponding execution. Refreshed PR 20628 comments do not decide those forms.
blockers.risk: Runtime invalid opcode cannot establish a structural rejection; successful reference-result execution cannot establish a new permission.
blockers.draftImpact: Retain current explicit uncertainty and separate PHP86-004 constant-object rules.
blockers.remediation: Obtain intended-validity evidence before proposing the smallest contextual correction. Gate B must cover ordinary/reference/list bases, result kinds, operations, discarded/live forms and VM profiles.

blockers.classification: unresolved intended compatibility; verified contextual traversal observation
blockers.construct: Optimized printf/sprintf, arrays and constant-expression traversal versus ordinary calls
blockers.missingEvidence: General intended language boundary and complete dispatch/visited-AST correspondence. PR 19658 discussion addresses optimization and constant collection, not a universal discarded-cast validity rule.
blockers.risk: An unconditional argument-traversal rule would wrongly accept or reject source.
blockers.draftImpact: Phase 5D informative scope remains accurate; preserve bounded observations.
blockers.candidateImpact: Blocks complete traversal claim and promotion.
blockers.remediation: Resolve intent and dispatch semantics; retain direct/imported/qualified/namespace/dynamic/named/unpack/PFA controls and logical/ternary/coalesce/array/live/discarded cases. No function-specific EBNF without structural evidence.

blockers.construct: Unknown property-hook name in a discarded declaration
blockers.missingEvidence: Separate policy disposition and authorization before changing the intentional get/set-only structural restriction.
blockers.risk: EBNF rejects an unknown hook that Zend can accept after discarding its declaration; blanket parser-equivalence claim is false.
blockers.draftImpact: Retain documented divergence without modifying either version.
blockers.candidateImpact: Independent PHP 8.6 certification must explicitly adjudicate the narrowed claim; historical acceptance is not automatically inherited.
blockers.stableImpact: Cannot silently treat it as exact parser equivalence.
blockers.remediation: If policy authorizes equivalence correction, consider identifier in hook-name with compilation-time get/set validation. Gate B needs live/discarded controls, canonical/parity changes and a separate PHP 8.5 correction review.

blockers.classification: documented enforcement limitation plus unresolved predicate evidence
blockers.construct: 73 inherited contextual restriction descriptions and changed-rule interactions
blockers.missingEvidence: Individual RC4 predicates, upstream PHPT and positive/negative stage isolation wherever family-level references remain. No native complete contextual validator exists.
blockers.risk: Structural matches may violate parser actions, compiler checks or deferred linking; historical readonly-default restriction labels must not be copied as current rules.
blockers.draftImpact: Document external enforcement and current normative clauses.
blockers.candidateImpact: Requires independent evidence and claim adjudication; not an automatic permissible release limitation.
blockers.stableImpact: Blocks whole-source-validator claims; bounded grammar certification requires policy disposition.
blockers.remediation: Prioritize retained/discarded declarations, type/member constraints, writable/reference forms, attributes, enum and constant-expression paths. Reuse hashed finding fixtures and add only missing isolating evidence in an authorized phase.

blockers.construct: 64 unexercised productions, 318 alternatives; scanner state/helper products; family-only parser correspondence
blockers.missingEvidence: Alternative-specific correspondence/AST binding, scanner state products and individual witnesses. The 51 source/profile entries are not 51 verified scanner rules.
blockers.risk: Coverage or name/section association can conceal a validity/binding mismatch; no defect follows solely from low coverage.
blockers.draftImpact: Retain every identity and justified obligation without deleting alternatives.
blockers.candidateImpact: Requires independent gap disposition under the conformance policy.
blockers.stableImpact: Not an automatic exemption from scanner, binding and classified-coverage gates.
blockers.remediation: Prioritize reserved token categories (including context-only from), namespace/type/declaration alternatives, dereference/constructor forms and closed-yield/prefix/dangling-else binding. Test lexical bodies through scanner primitives, not invented chart coverage.

blockers.construct: RC4 distributions, configuration profiles and final-release correspondence
blockers.missingEvidence: Proven exact-pin build, independent PHP 8.6 prerelease release-runner evidence, subsequent RC/final-source review and final release gates. Upstream PHPT suite was not run.
blockers.risk: Matching immutable source hashes do not prove executable ancestry; RC4 cannot certify a final release.
blockers.draftImpact: Report source-backed and executable-backed evidence separately.
blockers.candidateImpact: Preparation is possible; current evidence does not authorize promotion.
blockers.remediation: Prepare build provenance and independent gate inputs, then seek authorization for the separate certification phase; compare subsequent releases incrementally.

originalDefinitions.readinessScope: Preparation and evidence-backed proposals only. No speculative writable/traversal rule, historical hook correction, certification execution or status promotion is authorized or performed.

narrowlySatisfied: Source mechanism and finite paired behavior identified.
Independent alternatives and publication-scope assessment recorded.
remaining: No accepted release exclusion for discarded unknown hooks.
No intended-validity decision sufficient for normative correction.
